history.detail: Wired Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online into Superlocal’s local host on top of upstream R44VC0RP/superlocal main. Settings can now start a host-managed Entra OAuth flow, store encrypted Graph tokens, and add Outlook mailboxes. Existing configs without providers.outlook still load with Outlook disabled.

completion.summary: Wired Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online into Superlocal’s local host on top of upstream R44VC0RP/superlocal main. Settings can now start a host-managed Entra OAuth flow, store encrypted Graph tokens, and add Outlook mailboxes. Existing configs without providers.outlook still load with Outlook disabled.

criteria.criterion: Working copy is based on upstream R44VC0RP/superlocal main (or equivalent fetched main) before host Outlook work lands
criteria.evidence: Commit 712f1a1e parents main@upstream b88124ab (Merge pull request #4). Work started with jj new main@upstream after fetching R44VC0RP/superlocal.

criteria.criterion: apps/local-host can enable providers.outlook with Entra client id/secret (and tenant), mirroring Gmail config/env patterns
criteria.evidence: apps/local-host/src/config.ts adds providers.outlook with tenant plus oauth.clientId/clientSecret/scopes; defaults use SUPERLOCAL_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and optional SUPERLOCAL_MICROSOFT_TENANT. apps/local-host/src/providers.ts registers outlook when enabled.

criteria.criterion: Host-managed Microsoft OAuth start/callback exists, stores encrypted tokens, and registers the built-in outlook provider with Graph base URL and refresh
criteria.evidence: packages/inbox-sdk/server/microsoft-oauth.ts and microsoft-oauth-api.ts implement PKCE/JWKS OAuth at /v1/oauth/outlook/*; local-host mounts the callback and uses builtIn('outlook', 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0') with createMicrosoftCredentialRefresh.

criteria.criterion: Existing superlocal.local.json files without outlook still load; new defaults include outlook disabled
criteria.evidence: loadLocalConfig treats missing providers.outlook as enabled:false tenant:common. apps/local-host/src/config.test.ts covers that path; defaults() writes outlook.enabled false for new files.

criteria.criterion: README documents M365/Exchange Online connect steps including redirect URI
criteria.evidence: README provider table and Connect real providers steps now cover Entra registration, http://localhost:5178/v1/oauth/outlook/callback, tenant, and SUPERLOCAL_MICROSOFT_* env names.

criteria.criterion: Verification: bun --no-env-file typecheck/build and targeted host/SDK tests for the new OAuth/config path
criteria.evidence: bun --no-env-file run typecheck, typecheck:host, and build passed. bun --no-env-file test apps/local-host/src/config.test.ts (3 pass) and packages/inbox-sdk/tests/microsoft-oauth.test.ts (5 pass). test:web 40 pass.
